It was the second year of college for the two students I was talking to, one of them from a poor family and the other from a rich family. The poor student had aced all their classes in their first year even though they were taking upper level classes as a freshman. But the rich student was considering dropping out to avoid having to retake two courses they failed the previous semester. Who is doing well in college?
A. The rich student
B. Unknown
C. The poor student
